title: Hardest Vanilla
description: Makes minecraft much more difficult without taking the immersion of vanilla away.
body:
This datapack cranks up Minecraft’s difficulty without changing the core gameplay. 

features :
- No armor.
- No natural healing.
- No sleeping.
- No revive.
- Stronger mobs at night.
- Stronger boss fights

See the README.txt in the datapack folder for details.
